info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Workforce Contract Management API
info.description: The Workforce Contract Management API enables organizations to update and manage workforce contracts effectively. This API allows users to modify existing contract details, ensuring compliance and alignment with business needs. Typical consumers include HR departments and contract administrators who require seamless integration to maintain updated records. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance efficiency in contract management and improve workforce relations.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific employee's workforce contract, identified by their unique employee ID. Make sure to include the necessary fields that need to be updated in your request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the workforce contract details for the employee with ID EMP-900045. It contains the necessary fields to modify the existing contract information.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the workforce contract was updated.
